table.purpose: t01 appears to be a dimension/entity table (one row per entity, ~32k rows) keyed by a surrogate ID. Each row carries a segment code (SME/LAM/KAM) and a currency code (CZK/EUR). The Czech context (CZK dominant) and segment codes suggest banking/finance customer segmentation, but the table's exact subject cannot be confirmed from the given evidence alone, so the table itself remains unresolved beyond being a keyed reference table referenced by t05 and t04.

col_001.name: entity_id
col_001.description: Surrogate primary key; unique integer identifier for each row of t01. Referenced by t05.col_001 and t04.col_004 (many-to-one), so it identifies the entity those tables point to.

col_002.name: segment_code
col_002.description: Three-valued classification code: SME (small and medium enterprises, 82%), LAM (likely large/Local Area Market or large accounts, 11%), KAM (key account management, 6%). Plausibly a customer segment classification in a banking context; the exact expansion of LAM/KAM is tentative.

col_003.name: currency_code
col_003.description: ISO 4217 currency code: CZK (Czech koruna, 94%) and EUR (euro, 6%). Indicates the currency associated with the entity.

table.name: gasstations
table.purpose: Product/brand-level records (likely products) with a brand reference, a country market (Czech Republic or Slovakia), and a market positioning/price tier category. Each row is one item identified by a unique numeric id, referenced by t04 (likely a sales/transactions table).

col_001.name: product_id
col_001.description: Primary key; unique integer identifier for each row (likely a product). Referenced by t04.col_006, suggesting t04 holds per-transaction or per-time-series records for these items.

col_002.name: brand_id
col_002.description: Foreign key to t03.col_001 (and matching t04.col_001), identifying the brand/manufacturer of the item. 233 distinct brands, with brand 3 the most common.

col_003.name: country_code
col_003.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code: CZE (Czech Republic) or SVK (Slovakia), indicating the market/country of the item.

col_004.name: market_tier
col_004.description: Market positioning / price-tier label of the item: Premium, Value for money, Discount, Noname, or Other. Exact business definitions of 'Noname' and 'Other' are not further specified.

table.name: transaction_item
table.purpose: Line items of transactions, each row a charge/service/product entry (fuel, tolls, fees, services) with an identifier and a Czech/English description; referenced by t04 and t02 as a lookup of item codes.

col_001.name: item_id
col_001.description: Primary key: unique integer identifier (1-630) for each transaction line item / charge code; referenced by t04.col_007, t04.col_008 and t02.col_002.

col_002.name: item_description
col_002.description: Free-text description/label of the charged item or service (e.g. 'Katalyzátor', 'Servisní poplatek', 'Toll access-Austria', 'AdBlue (jerrycan)', 'Potraviny'). Mostly Czech with some English; not unique (591 rows, 529 distinct).

table.purpose: Each row is an event/transaction record with a date, a time, several foreign keys to t01, t02, t03, and a monetary-looking amount. The table's own meaning beyond that is unresolved: names are opaque and no lookup labels are provided. The 4-day date window (2068-08-23 to 2068-08-26) suggests a batch of records from a short period, possibly a test or future-dated dataset.

col_001.name: record_id
col_001.description: Primary key of t04; sequential integer 1-1000, one per row.

col_002.name: event_date
col_002.description: Date of the record, stored as VARCHAR. Only 4 distinct dates (2068-08-23 to 2068-08-26), heavily concentrated on the 24th and 25th. The future year suggests synthetic or mis-encoded data; the column is a date but what it dates is unresolved.

col_003.name: event_time
col_003.description: Time of day (HH:MM) stored as text, spread across the day. Pairs with col_002 as a timestamp. What event it timestamps is unresolved.

col_009.name: amount
col_009.description: Decimal amount, 1.76 to 5762.49 with right-skewed distribution (median 354). Plausibly a monetary amount or measured quantity, but no currency/unit evidence, so the specific meaning is tentative.

table.name: yearmonth
table.purpose: Monthly records of a monetary amount per entity (account/customer) identified by col_001, one row per entity per year-month. Likely a monthly balance, turnover, or transaction-total fact table keyed on (col_001, col_002). The exact business measure in col_003 is not fully determinable from the data alone.

col_001.name: entity_id
col_001.description: Identifier of the entity (e.g. account or customer) this monthly record belongs to. References t01.col_001 many-to-one; each id appears ~12-20 times, consistent with one row per month per entity.

col_002.name: period_ym
col_002.description: Year and month of the record in YYYYMM form (values 201112 through 201311, i.e. Dec 2011 to Nov 2013). Stored as VARCHAR but numeric; should be read as a year-month period, not a plain integer.

col_003.name: amount
col_003.description: Monetary amount for the entity in that month (currency units unknown). Highly variable, mostly positive (median ~1766, max ~2,052,187) but with some negative values down to -582,092. Could be a monthly balance, turnover, or net transaction total; the negative values suggest a signed measure (net amount or balance) rather than a pure count. Exact semantics unresolved.
